question_text: A square sheet of paper is folded in half vertically, then folded in half horizontally, and then a hole is punched through all layers at a point that is 2 cm from the left edge and 3 cm from the bottom edge of the original sheet. The paper is then unfolded. Which of the following best describes the pattern of holes?

options.text: Four holes arranged in a square, each 2 cm from the left and right edges and 3 cm from the top and bottom edges
Four holes arranged in a square, each 2 cm from the left and right edges and 3 cm from the top and bottom edges, but mirrored horizontally and vertically
Two holes, one at (2,3) and one at (2, height-3) from the left and bottom
One hole at the center of the paper
